title: Code of Practice for Earthing
scope: Applies to the earthing of electrical installations for generation, transmission, distribution and utilization of electrical energy.
qco_reference: Central Electricity Authority (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations / S.O. 1198(E)

clauses.title: Earthing of Frame and Metal Casings
clauses.text: All metal casings, enclosures, and non-current carrying metal parts shall be effectively connected to earth with minimum two separate and distinct connections.

clauses.title: Earth Resistance Measurement
clauses.text: The earth resistance of the earthing system shall not exceed 1.0 Ohm for substations and 2.0 Ohms for industrial generating plants.
